chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, raising it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
When it is the middle of Sha'ban, pray four Rak'at, reciting in each Rak'at Al-Hamd and Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad one hundred times.

When you finish, say: 'O Allah, I am needy to You, and I seek Refuge with You, and fearful from You, and Sanctuary with You. Lord, do not change my name. Lord, do not change my body. Lord, do not overload my afflictions. I seek Refuge with Your Pardon from Your Punishment, and I seek Refuge with Your Pleasure from Your Wrath, and I seek Refuge with Your Mercy from Your Punishment, and I seek Refuge with You from You. Majestic is Your Praise. You are as You Praised Yourself, and above what the speakers are saying.'

He said, and Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: On the day of the twenty-seventh of Rajab, news was given to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) regarding it: 'Whoever prays in it at any time he desires, twelve Rak'at, reciting in each Rak'at with the Mother of the Quran and a Chapter whatever is easy.'
When he finishes and gives Salam, he sits in his place, then recites the Mother of the Quran four times, and the three Mu'awwidhat (Chapters 112, 113, 114), each one four times.
When he finishes and he is in his place, he says: 'La ilaha illa Allah, wa Allahu Akbar, wa al-hamdu lillah, wa subhan Allah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' four times.

Then he says: 'Allah, Allah Rabbi, la ushriku bihi shay'an' four times, then he supplicates, so he does not supplicate with anything except that it is answered for him regarding every need, except if he were to supplicate regarding a catastrophe (to befall upon a) people, or cutting-off of a relationship.

key_terms.أُمُّ الْقُرْآن: Umm al-Qur'an (The Mother of the Quran, referring to Surah Al-Fatiha)
key_terms.الْمُعَوِّذَات: Al-Mu'awwidhat (The three chapters of protection, Surahs 112, 113, 114)
key_terms.رَجَب: Rajab (the seventh month of the Islamic lunar calendar)
key_terms.شَعْبَان: Sha'ban (the eighth month of the Islamic lunar calendar)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific prayers and supplications recommended for the 15th and 27th of Sha'ban and Rajab?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi prescribes specific devotional prayers for the 15th of Sha'ban (often associated with the birth of Imam al-Husayn or the appearance of Imam al-Mahdi) and the 27th of Rajab (Laylat al-Raghaib), emphasizing the recitation of Surah Al-Ikhlas and Al-Fatiha to invoke divine acceptance. The detailed supplications highlight themes of humility, protection from calamity, and the certainty of answered prayers, provided one avoids severing family ties or causing harm to others. These rituals reflect the Shia tradition of linking specific lunar dates with heightened spiritual efficacy and intercessory prayer.
